label: PF Backlog 242
title: Backlog destination-tagged ids (BI-<TAG>-<nnn>)
body: New backlog ids encode the destination: PF (Product Forge backend/pipeline), DASH (dashboard), IN (raw intake idea), <PROJECT-SLUG> (project being built / existing project). Legacy BI-#### ids remain valid and are read identically. tag_for() derives the tag; add_epic/ensure_item accept an explicit tag override; parsers updated (_BARE_BI_RE, migrate_backlog_refs, gen_backlog_summary, project_journal).
